official_config_differences: Official CIFAR config uses 5 initial classes and 5-class increments; matched implementation check uses the agreed 10-class split.
Official class shuffle is disabled for the matched implementation check.
Pretrained checkpoint is pinned to the selected AugReg IN21K->IN1K family rather than inferred from an alias.
validation.repeat_policy: Matched seed1993 completed and passed every metric and structural check. No additional seed is required for this implementation acceptance. Single-seed results do not estimate across-seed variation; paper reproduction may use additional matched seeds in a later stage.
validation.margin_policy: User-confirmed: each of four accuracy metrics passes at <=1.5pp drop, requires review at >1.5pp and <=3.0pp, and fails at >3.0pp. Any structural failure is a failure. Fail overrides review; review overrides pass. Both review and fail block merging and advancement until resolved.

accuracy_policy.drop_definition: matched official reference accuracy minus native accuracy; improvements pass
accuracy_policy.overall_rule: Fail if any metric fails or any structural check fails. Otherwise review if any metric requires review. Pass only if all four metrics and structural checks pass.
accuracy_policy.review_action: Investigate implementation, data and training differences and record the resolution. Review is not acceptance and does not permit merging or advancement to the efficiency pilot.
accuracy_policy.comparison_precision: Use correct/sample counts or unrounded accuracy; do not classify from display-rounded percentages.
accuracy_policy.basis: User-selected operational margins, not a statistical tolerance inferred from the single reference seed.

validation.execution_scope: native first two tasks and result reporting only; no efficiency pilot, Tiny/Small training or merge

efficiency.flops: One separate partial-operator diagnostic run after three measurements
efficiency.repeat_policy: Three fresh-process measurement runs with seed1993, then one separate FLOPs pass with the same seed/config; median and min/max report only measurement observations.
efficiency.execution_scope: EASE Base64 only; first task, one epoch; after successful measurements and logging verification, local merge into codex/cl-foundation; no remote push.
efficiency.precision: FP32, no autocast, CUDA matmul TF32 off; cuDNN deterministic and benchmark disabled, matched native acceptance.
efficiency.accuracy_policy: One-epoch pilot accuracy is recorded; twenty-epoch reference margins are not applied. Non-finite or structurally invalid behavior fails.

before_port_acceptance: Completed: native seed1993 first-two-task protocol and the confirmed 1.5/3.0pp policy.
Completed: pinned Base checkpoint, matched raw data, frozen backbone and old adapters verified.
Completed: W&B finished/COMMITTED artifact readback and Slack delivery statuses verified.
remaining_steps: Decide first-task/one-epoch efficiency pilot scope and separate FLOPs pass.
Review local codex/ease changes and decide merge timing; no merge performed in this stage.
Tiny/Small and ratio-aligned adapter experiments in a later approved stage.
Paper reproduction and BudgetCL/aL-SAR budget comparisons in later stages.
variant_execution_tracking: For prepared variants, executed/efficiency_executed track the unexecuted efficiency experiment; validation_executed separately records Base first-two-task acceptance.
